beforeShellExecution.command: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; common=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); hooks=$(git config --local --no-includes --get core.hooksPath); case "$hooks" in "$common"/repo-hooks/versions/*/hooks) exec "$hooks/cursor" ;; *) echo "Reviewed repository hooks are not installed" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
